drafts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity game interface redesign proposal for 桃园小英雄, an existing Chinese chibi Three Kingdoms mobile game.
Output: ONE full-screen landscape screenshot-style concept, 2.1:1 wide aspect ratio (around 1680 by 800). Flat orthographic screen only, no phone/device mockup, no perspective, no captions outside the UI.
Art direction: preserve the provided game's big-headed tiny-body anime cartoon heroes, thick dark-brown outlines, warm cel colours, illustrated straw shoes and weapons, sage grass with small flowers. Interface palette deep jade green, warm ivory, dark ink brown, muted gold, one vermilion primary action. Restrained, polished, airy, consistent hand-painted 2D game UI; no shiny metallic fantasy frames, no neon, no giant ornaments. Chinese labels must be legible and correct.
Safe area: reserve the top-right 190×65 corner for the small native WeChat capsule (dark translucent pill with three dots and circle icon); no custom control overlapping or adjacent to it. Keep interactive controls clear of all edges and the bottom home-indicator area. The native capsule is system chrome, not a restyled game button.

Input images: image1 is the current menu layout (reference only); image2 is its original clean peach training-ground background to preserve; image3 is the current new game title logo to reproduce; image4 contains the existing Liu Bei / Guan Yu / Zhang Fei identities in its TOP ROW.
Screen: simplified hero-selection home menu.
Crucial requested change: REMOVE the entire central title banner "选择英雄". Leave the top centre as open sky with no replacement heading, instruction, subtitle or decorative plaque. The only game title is the small authentic "桃园小英雄" brown brush logo in the TOP LEFT, matching reference image3, comfortably inset.
Composition: retain the peaceful peach training-ground landscape, not a battle poster. One proudly standing Liu Bei centred on the dirt area, large head / small torso and tiny feet, two short arms firmly gripping two straw shoes; cheerful mischievous expression, no straight arms crossing face. Hero feet about mid-height. A small jade name pill "刘备" just below him.
Lower third: one compact centred dark translucent horizontal portrait rail containing EXACTLY FIVE equal square head-only portraits, in this order Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun (silver helmet/blue plume), Kongming (black scholar cap). Golden outline only around selected Liu Bei. Immediately to the RIGHT of the rail place one smaller round skill button, displaying only the cloud-running-shoes skill icon, no title/statistics/cooldown text.
Bottom centre: ONE dominant warm vermilion hand-painted button with ivory text "开始". Bottom left: a quieter small jade book-icon button labelled "图鉴", on the same baseline as Start. No large secondary panels. Keep generous separation between hero, nameplate, portraits and actions.
Do not add custom buttons in the top right. No pause button on this menu, no health/currency HUD, no character statistics, weapon selection or test mode. No "选择英雄" anywhere. No text paragraphs. Make it look ready for the existing game, with only hierarchy and spacing refined.

Input image: current in-game shop screenshot, to preserve game art/weapon icons and show the layout being improved. Redesign its layout substantially.
Screen: mid-battle shop as ONE centred semi-transparent deep jade modal panel, roughly 80% of screen width and 82% of screen height, with restrained warm gold rim and plenty of internal space. Behind it a frozen grassy battle field with a few faint chibi soldiers; stage remains visible through/around the panel, darker and quieter. Hide ALL underlying combat HUD, joystick, skill button and custom pause button while shopping; retain only the native top-right WeChat capsule. No overlapping player portraits or hearts behind cards.
Header INSIDE modal: left-aligned title "桃园补给"; far right one small gold coin icon followed by "28", as a simple non-interactive balance readout WITHOUT a button-shaped box or the word 铜钱. One short muted helper "可购买多件" under the title, no paragraph. Header clear of native capsule.
Middle: EXACTLY THREE equally sized rounded merchandise cards in one row, with clear 24-32px gaps. Large recognisable illustrated item, name, two short stat lines, aligned purchase button at same bottom baseline. All typography/price positions consistent.
Card1: cream rarity chip "普通 I"; illustrated golden woven straw sandal, title "草鞋"; stats "伤害16 · 0.60秒" and "投掷草鞋1只"; purchase button with coin icon and "28 购买".
Card2: cream rarity chip "普通 I"; recognisable brown peach BRANCH with pink blossoms and green leaves, title "桃花枝"; stats "伤害26 · 1.00秒" and "1片花瓣 · 爆散55"; purchase button with coin icon and "16 购买".
Card3: subtle lavender item chip "道具"; original winged courier parcel illustration; title "顺风快递"; stats "弹体飞行速度 +25%" and "自动生效"; purchase button with coin icon and "28 购买".
Use jade cards slightly more opaque than the modal; restrained quality borders, warm ivory text, no excessive frames or oversized empty space.
Below cards: a SEPARATE unified equipment strip. Small "武器 1/6" label, followed by EXACTLY SIX compact evenly spaced weapon squares: first contains the sandal and tiny I, the next FIVE are empty with muted plus signs. At the RIGHT END of that same strip a small quiet bag icon button "道具 0"; visually grouped with equipment, not floating by itself.
Very bottom INSIDE modal: ONE action row with shared baseline. Left a modest ivory secondary button containing circular-refresh icon, "刷新" and a coin icon "5". Right a larger vermilion primary button "继续战斗" with a small forward arrow. Wide calm empty space between these two buttons. Do not add another footer instruction sentence, central button or duplicate balance.
All content fits above the home indicator. Align header/cards/equipment/action rows to a consistent grid. This should feel uncluttered and functional, not like a menu with scattered floating controls.

Input image: actual in-game battle frame. Preserve its simple top-down grassy field, tiny chibi Liu Bei/Yellow Turban soldiers, limited gold crescent attack effect, fixed joystick, six weapon slots and one skill button. This is a UI POSITION/STYLE design, not new combat content.
Specific redesign: move the game's own PAUSE button OUT OF the top-right corner. Top-left status panel is one compact translucent jade card, with small Liu Bei portrait, his name "刘备", exactly FIVE heart icons, then a small coin icon and "28". Immediately to the RIGHT of this status card, separated by a comfortable small gap, place a compact circular pause button: jade face, fine muted-gold rim, two clear ivory pause bars. Align its vertical centre with the status card's centre. No giant square green pause button anywhere. Leave the entire top-right region clear except for the native WeChat capsule.
Top centre: tiny calm countdown "00:24", no stage/level text. Centre/lower battlefield remains open and readable; chibi Liu Bei with a short restrained golden slash and a few small enemies, no huge cinematic particles.
Bottom left: fixed large translucent circular joystick with a clear inner thumb knob and subtle ivory/gold outline. Bottom right: skill button showing only the cloud-running-shoes icon, same centre baseline as joystick; small "就绪" label below. Bottom centre: EXACTLY SIX compact weapon slots, first sandal with I, next FIVE empty. No experience, level number or additional action buttons.
Use consistent jade/ivory/gold control styling, with ample safety margins. Keep selected hero and enemies at real top-down gameplay proportions, no enlarged full-body portrait in battle, no new map props, no multiple utility buttons or instruction overlays.

battleHudCorrection.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the provided battle HUD redesign concept for 桃园小英雄.
Change ONLY the image inside the circular skill button at the LOWER RIGHT: replace the ordinary straw-sandal drawing with a clearly recognisable GOLDEN-WHITE CRESCENT SLASH icon for 横扫六合, matching the gold crescent attack seen in the battlefield. This is a golden sweeping blade arc with a bright ivory leading edge and a small trailing streak on dark jade, NOT a shoe, arrow or sword item icon.
Preserve the circular button shape, size, position, gold rim and the exact "就绪" label beneath it. Preserve ALL other UI, all five hearts, avatar, names, the pause button beside the upper-left health panel, six weapon slots, joystick, enemies, character, grass, attack effect, native capsule and layout exactly. Do not add text or alter the gameplay scene. Same landscape dimensions, same painterly 2D game art. This remains a DESIGN CONCEPT, not a runtime screenshot.
battleHudCorrection.note: Lower-right skill icon corrected to a crescent slash for G03. Only the final corrected proposal is retained in the project.

limitations: Concepts are AI-generated mockups, not runtime screenshots.
Existing game character/weapon/skill assets must be reused in implementation; concept icons and invented scenery do not replace runtime assets.
Shop and battle examples use illustrative combat state and numbers, not a player save or gameplay record.
